reader_question: Which everyday answers rest on the most claims?
grade_line: Documented: the atlas’s own register of graded claims
title: Of the atlas’s 16 everyday answers, voting and public influence rests on the most claims, 42, and roads, bridges and transit on the fewest, 13.
measure_line: Claims in the atlas’s register behind each of its 16 everyday answers, 433 claims in all, checked through October 15, 2026, United States. Stems start at zero.
notes: A count shows how many claims an answer cites. How sure each claim is depends on its own grade, which the atlas gives claim by claim.

The answer with the most claims takes the reader’s question “Which election decides who represents me, and how can I influence the people who decide?”; the one with the fewest, “Why is the repair on my street taking so long?”
alt: Lollipops rank the atlas’s 16 everyday answers by the claims behind each. Voting and public influence leads with 42, then pay and working conditions with 39 and housing costs with 34; roads, bridges and transit has the fewest, 13. The 16 answers rest on 433 claims in all.
chart_notes: The two answers the title names are drawn in the text’s ink; the other 14 are gray.
